profile.headline: Software Engineer at ClearGov | Stanford ’25
profile.summary: B.S. in Computer Science in Artificial Intelligence from Stanford University. Passionate about UX, good design, and innovative solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer and Data Specialist
positions.description:
Collaborated with clients and project managers to design and configure Cityspan's software systems for client-specific data and reporting needs.
Designed and maintained SAP BusinessObjects Universes to support client self-service reporting in SAP Web Intelligence.
Built and customized SAP Web Intelligence reports to meet client reporting specifications and data analysis needs.
Authored ad-hoc SQL queries and optimized database scripts to extract, validate, and analyze client data.
Cleaned, mapped, and transformed datasets from multiple sources for integration into production systems.
Developed and maintained internal management and diligence tools, improving operational efficiency and data quality assurance.
Acquired by Gravity in October 2025

positions.title: Student Engagement Assistant
positions.description:
Collaborated with the Director of Academic and Public Programs to produce lively and dynamic events for Stanford students at the museum.
Assisted in organizing and executing Museum Nights, managing resources effectively, ensuring that the events ran smoothly.
Worked to build community across campus by exploring and implementing various events with other on-campus groups.
Facilitated the Cantor’s connection to student life and activities.

positions.title: Summer College Readiness Coordinator
positions.description:
Managed a caseload of 200 first-generation and low-income high school seniors and undergraduates, offering personalized guidance and support throughout the college application process, financial aid application, and enrollment preparation.
Conducted workshops and informational sessions on college admissions, financial aid, and career planning, fostering a better understanding among students and parents.
Redesigned the high school curriculum in collaboration with the college and career department, aligning coursework with current college admission requirements and career trends.
Led the design and execution of an Alumni Association project aimed at revitalizing connections with graduates from the past 20 years.
Actively participated in professional development opportunities to stay current with best practices in college readiness, educational technology, and student support services.

company.name: "I Have A Dream"​ Foundation of Boulder County

positions.title: Teaching Fellow
positions.description:
Completed intensive diversity and classroom management training
Crafted daily lesson plans and taught seventh grade math in a classroom setting
Designed curriculum and taught middle school Power of Emotions, coding and robotics electives
Advisor to seventh graders with daily check-ins and collaboration space
One-on-one tutoring and instruction

Received 2022 Community Teacher award

positions.title: Arts Intern
positions.description:
Designed and facilitated Museum Festivus Maximus Events once a semester, strengthening our connection with Denver teens and artists.
Facilitated Black Sheep Fridays, a weekly arts-intensive for the Denver community to collaborate and foster creativity.
Curated and installed three Teen Art Shows with artwork from Denver-area teens, additionally holding opening night celebrations once a year.
Developed and produced three art-installations taking over the Teen Idea Box with original artwork and holding opening night celebrations.

positions.title: Maker Space Facilitator
positions.description:
Managed Denver’s ideaLAB, a space where tools such as laser-cutters, 3D printers, sticker machines and a recording studio were available to no charge to the community.
Facilitated Library children’s events, designing and producing sets and decorations for the library's annual events.

projects.title: Malaria Detection Network
projects.description: Built and trained a neural network (classifier) to classify P. vivax malaria-infected red blood cells into their stage of infection. Previous implementations of malaria classifiers were built for the strain P. falciparum and could only classify as 'Infected' or 'Not Infected.'

projects.title: Venture Intelligence Engine
projects.description: Built a comprehensive dashboard for VC firms to quickly and accurately access real-time company data to source leads. Included the ability to find news articles, classify companies by firm preferences, as well as natural language search. Was developed in partnership with a VC firm to implement as a daily tool.
